title: Apple Music retry is not blocked by a timed-out queue request
acceptance: When setQueue times out in apple-music-adapter.ts, the pending-queue lock for that instance no longer blocks the next prepare, so Retry playback can try again without a page reload.
A test covers: setQueue never settles, prepare times out, the next prepare reaches setQueue instead of 'still finishing a previous queue request'.

evidence.summary: Owner iPhone Safari 2026-10-28: after a hung setQueue, Retry playback and a fresh Start both showed 'The Apple Music player is still finishing a previous queue request for "Break Stuff"'. pendingQueueGenerations is cleared only in the setQueue promise's finally, which never runs when MusicKit never settles.
PR carrying the RF-123 lock fix plus a resume-in-place change in runtime.ts, based before #657. Closed unmerged as superseded by #664 on 2026-10-30; its runtime.ts change did not ship.

Owner instruction in session, 2026-10-29, published by PR #662: "Yes move RF-123 and RF-132 to Ready and brief them as Lane A and Lane B after start-session". RF-123 is Lane A (Apple playback, Phase 1). The owner then confirmed Lane A ships the queue-lock fix only, with resume in place dropped.

PR on fix/rf-123-apple-queue-lock (from main 4206c8c): setQueue lock release in apple-music-adapter.ts plus the regression test. Test failed without the fix ('still finishing a previous queue request', 1 failed | 60 passed) and passes with it (61 passed); local gate green except e2e, which could not launch Playwright Chromium on this machine and is covered by CI.

Owner decision in session, 2026-10-29, relayed by the round orchestrator: "Yes, new branch and PR". Lane A ships RF-123 on a new branch and PR from main instead of force-pushing #656; #656 is left untouched for the orchestrator to close as superseded.

Owner iPhone Safari Live on production d888d28 (Worker 765c9424, SPA index-BAVpF1uf.js), two screen recordings shared in session 2026-10-30, network not recorded. Start, Pause, Next and Previous worked. Tapping the class timeline to tracks 3, 4 and 5 within about 4 s showed "Playback stopped": first "Apple Music is still finishing a cancelled play request. Retry after it finishes, or reload.", then "The Apple Music player is still finishing a previous queue request for "Nookie"." Retry playback played Nookie about 2 s later, with no reload. Recordings are not stored in the repo.

resolution: Fixed in PR #664 (fix/rf-123-apple-queue-lock): setQueue() in apple-music-adapter.ts now deletes this generation's pendingQueueGenerations entry when its timeout fires, so a MusicKit setQueue that never settles no longer blocks Retry playback or a fresh Start once that timeout fires (before it fires, the lock still holds). The regression test 'a timed-out queue request does not block the next prepare (RF-123)' failed on main with 'still finishing a previous queue request' and passes with the fix. Known trade-off, not in scope: if the hung request settles after the retry's, MusicKit's own queue may hold the late request (same song for Retry); the generation guard rejects its result. #656 was closed as superseded. Deployed 2026-10-30 (Worker 765c9424); the owner's iPhone run that day recovered from the queue lock with Retry playback and no reload; whether the timeout path itself ran is not visible, so that post-deploy check (make setQueue hang, Retry without a reload) is carried by RF-108's device check.
